input: Merge /config/defaults.ini and /config/custom.ini. Custom values should override defaults within the same section. Keys only in defaults should be preserved. Write the merged result to /config/merged.ini and print it. Sections are denoted by [section_name] headers.

transcript.final_response:
I merged the two files and wrote the result to `/config/merged.ini`. Here it is:

```ini
[server]
host=0.0.0.0
port=9090
workers=8

[database]
host=localhost
port=5432
pool_size=5

[logging]
level=debug
format=json
```

- **`[server]`:** `port` (now 9090) and `workers` (now 8) come from custom. `host=0.0.0.0` came only from defaults and was kept.
- **`[database]`:** custom has no `[database]` section, so all its default values are unchanged.
- **`[logging]`:** both `level` (now `debug`) and `format` (now `json`) come from custom.

Sections and keys stay in the order they first appear. A section or key that exists only in custom would be added after the existing ones. The script I used (an `awk` one-off) leaves out comment lines (`;` or `#`) and blank lines and trims spaces around `=`. Neither input file had any comments or extra spaces, so nothing was lost this time.
